chunks: And I fear the relatives after me; and my wife is barren. So grant me a successor as a favour from You.

key_terms.الْمَوَالِيَ: Relatives or heirs who will succeed

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Zakariya pray for regarding his successor and legacy?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Zakariya (AS) articulates a dual concern for both dynastic continuity and spiritual succession, specifically invoking the title 'walī' (successor/guardian) which holds profound significance in Shia theology as a precursor to the Imams. His plea for a child from his barren wife highlights the miraculous nature of divine bestowal, linking the lineage of Prophethood to the Ahl al-Bayt. This supplication underscores the concept of 'walayah' as a divine appointment rather than mere hereditary succession.
